title: House Robber II
oneLinerQuestion: Maximize stolen amount in a circular arrangement of houses where first and last are connected.
explanation: Since house 0 and house N-1 are adjacent, run standard House Robber twice: once on subarray range [0..N-2] and once on range [1..N-1], returning max of both results.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION rob(nums):
    IF LENGTH(nums) == 1 THEN RETURN nums[0]
    RETURN MAX(robRange(nums, 0, LENGTH(nums)-2), robRange(nums, 1, LENGTH(nums)-1))
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION robRange(nums, start, end):
    r1 = 0, r2 = 0
    FOR i FROM start TO end DO:
        temp = MAX(nums[i] + r1, r2); r1 = r2; r2 = temp
    END FOR
    RETURN r2
END FUNCTION
